{{Quote|What’s your opinion of Major Pakrie?''"<br />"''In a word, ambitious. He’ll do anything necessary to advance his own career and fortune.|[[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and [[General]] [[Kauf Ularno]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Pakrie''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] in the [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He helped the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] in a failed attempt to seize control of the sector, but the attempt was thwarted by the [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] and the [[Hand of Judgment]].
